results.bound: $10^2\text{--}10^3\times$ reduction in model runtime during optimisation

results.problem: PROCESS fusion systems code optimization (stellarator configuration)
results.bound: $40\times$ speedup from removing orchestration overhead by compiling the cottax graph
results.previous_best: uncompiled cottax graph execution (interpreted Python orchestration)
results.quote: The timing results show two to three orders of magnitude less model time (i.e. not including driver computations) in cottax compared to base PROCESS, and show that removing orchestration overhead (by compiling the cottax graph) results in a 40× speedup in a stellarator configuration.

results.bound: $10^1\text{--}10^2\times$ faster evaluation and $10^2\text{--}10^3\times$ faster Jacobian computation than finite differences in base PROCESS
results.previous_best: finite differences used in base PROCESS
results.quote: The evaluation is one to two orders of magnitude faster and the cottax Jacobian computation is two to three orders of magnitude faster than the finite differences used in base PROCESS.
